name: Import CAD Format
explanation_long: Imports a CAD model from any supported file format into the application. This includes tessellation into a 3D mesh.
explanation: Imports a CAD model from any supported file format into the application. This includes tessellation into a 3D mesh.

exposed_options.name: Tessellation Resolution
exposed_options.description: Tessellation resolution for imported CAD surfaces. Fine refers to the most detailed and dense tessellation while coarse refers to a simple more apromixated tessellation for preview or proxy purposes.

exposed_options.name: CAD Sewing Tolerance
exposed_options.description: Tolerance for the sewing operation on the b-reps before tessellation. This especially helps with data introducing lots of surface patches by merging them into more coherent parts.

exposed_options.name: Remove T-Junctions
exposed_options.description: Attempts to remove T-Junctions after CAD tessellation. This is an experimental feature.

exposed_options.name: Convert Z- to Y-Up
exposed_options.description: Turns rotation to z-axis pointing upwards on/off. Helpful if origin axis system is Z-Up and target system is Y-Up.

exposed_options.name: Fix Winding Order
exposed_options.description: Automatically fix the winding order of parts on import.

exposed_options.name: Remove Occluded Parts
exposed_options.description: Removes invisible (occluded) parts from the 3D model on import.

exposed_options.name: Simplify Mesh
exposed_options.description: Decimates the tessellated mesh to a certain amount of faces during import.
